title: Concatenation of serialized fragments
statement: For CNF formulas $\varphi$ and $\psi$ over natural-number variables, the fragment of their concatenation is the concatenation of their fragments: $\mathrm{fragment}(\varphi ++ \psi)=\mathrm{fragment}(\varphi) ++ \mathrm{fragment}(\psi)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ and $\psi$ are CNF formulas over natural-number variables
replaced: For CNF formulas $\varphi$ and $\psi$, the serialized fragment of $\varphi$ followed by $\psi$ equals the fragment of $\varphi$ concatenated with the fragment of $\psi$, with all clauses kept in their original order.
